builds.name: Reference: Mana burn zones
builds.goal: Reference for Heimerdinger: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A setup mage who defends a turret position and accelerates turret beams by landing rockets or grenade. Fix turret count, placement and ultimate choice. Rockets/grenade accelerating beams matter; do not attribute every turret projectile to every item proc without checking. Mana and repeated ability damage may maintain burns and MR-reduction stacks.
testPlan: Kit question for Heimerdinger: Fix turret count, placement and ultimate choice. Rockets/grenade accelerating beams matter; do not attribute every turret projectile to every item proc without checking.

Start with the early core (Blackfire Torch, then Liandry) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Mana and repeated ability damage may maintain burns and MR-reduction stacks. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Heimerdinger lays down a rapid-fire cannon turret equipped with a secondary pass-through beam attack (turrets deal half damage to towers). Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Burn refresh is not unlimited independent stacking; measure target contact and debuff ramp.

kitEvidence.formula:
Heimerdinger unleashes a barrage of [5] rockets that deal [50 / 75 / 100 / 125 / 150 + (0.55) × AP] magic damage to the first enemy hit. Additional rocket hits deal reduced damage.

Max Damage: [90 / 135 / 180 / 225 / 270 + (1.03) × AP] magic damage.

Nearby Turrets gain 20% charge per rocket that hits a champion.

Heimerdinger upgrades his next non-ultimate Ability.

H-28Q Apex Turret: Place an upgraded Turret for 8 seconds that doesn't count towards Heimerdinger's max turrets, deals [80 / 100 / 120 + (0.35) × AP] magic damage per shot and [100 / 140 / 180 + (0.7) × AP] magic damage per charged shot. Its attacks deal damage in an area, Slow by 25% for 2 seconds, and it is immune to crowd control.

Hextech Rocket Swarm: Fires 4 waves of rockets that each deal [135 / 180 / 225 + (0.45) × AP] magic damage. Champions and jungle monsters hit by additional rockets take reduced damage, and minions take increased damage. Max Damage: [503 / 697.5 / 892 + (1.83) × AP] magic damage. 

CH-3X Lightning Grenade: Throws a bouncing grenade that discharges three times, dealing [100 / 200 / 300 + (0.6) × AP] magic damage. The Stun and Slow areas are larger.

Recast: Cancel this Ability.

Heimerdinger hurls a grenade that deals [60 / 100 / 140 / 180 / 220 + (0.6) × AP] magic damage in an area and Slows by @SlowPercent.0*100@% for [2] seconds. Enemies in the center are also Stunned for [1.5] seconds.

Hitting a champion fully charges nearby Turrets.

Heimerdinger constructs a Turret that attacks nearby enemies. Heimerdinger can have [3 / 3 / 3 / 3 / 3] turrets active at once. Turrets slowly build up charge. At max charge, they fire a stronger attack.

If Heimerdinger gets too far away, his Turrets will deactivate after 8 seconds.

This Ability has [3 / 3 / 3 / 3 / 3] charges.
Heimerdinger gains @MovementSpeed.0*100@% Move Speed near his Turrets and ally towers.
